question: How is the object ritually enveloped through the pure-principle creation?
premises: Pervasion by the creation of pure principles is the means.
The object is to be covered.
Smearing is performed as part of the act.
inference: By pervading it with the creation of pure principles, one smears and thus covers this object.
plain_english: Having smeared this by pervading it with the creation of the pure principles, thus having covered it.
